opening.argument: The speaker explains ways to earn online, including freelance services, ebook publishing, affiliate commissions and dropshipping. These are presented as methods to understand, not guaranteed returns: the continuing-income claim is expressly qualified as theoretical, and the larger earnings claims describe what some people can make. The description also discloses that purchases through affiliate links may earn the speaker a commission. Taken together, the explanations, qualifications and disclosure support an instructional overview of income possibilities. They do not establish that viewers will earn the amounts mentioned, or that the speaker conceals a financial interest.

citations.quote: Businesses and individuals post services on Upwork that they would like to outsource,. Such as article writing, video editing, app development, coding
The basic principle of dropshipping is, you create a store or any channel where people. Can buy stuff from you.
And the money in theory should keep rolling in, without you having to do any more work.
Some people make over $100,000 publishing Kindle eBooks on Amazon.
